ابتغين (form VIII)
# اِبْتَغَيْنَ (ibtaḡayna) /ib.ta.ɣaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
# اُبْتُغِينَ (ubtuḡīna) /ub.tu.ɣiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
# اِبْتَغِينَ (ibtaḡīna) /ib.ta.ɣiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
